title: Libre 2plus / 2+ additional sensor life not recognised
symptom: xDrip+ does not recognize the Libre 2+ sensor's increased standard life from 14 to 15 days. End-of-life prediction is incorrect, saying the sensor will expire a day early, and after it keeps running beyond 15 days xDrip reports age like 15.1 days and no longer offers an end time.
cause: xDrip+ does not differentiate between the Libre 2 and the Libre 2+ sensor, and continues to use the Libre 2's 14-day lifespan for Libre 2+ sensors.
fix: Update to the 2025.07.16 xDrip release, which addresses this by recognizing the Libre 2+ sensor and its 15-day lifespan (PR #4080). Testing of the fix confirmed the sensor is identified as 2plus and shows the correct end time of about 14.9/15 days.
evidence_quote: This should be addressed as of the 2025.07.16 release.
